dimension_evidence.diagnosis: The Prompt exposes the side-effecting-versus-pure behavioral distinction, but the agent must understand that symbolic tracing retains a callable packet while an effect may be declared through its default overload. This is one representation and registration contract rather than a multi-backend or multi-state diagnosis.
dimension_evidence.localization: Although FX graph cleanup is public, the repair is not in that method. The agent must trace dead-code elimination through node impurity classification into library effect handling and relate the symbolically traced callable target to the registered operation representation.
dimension_evidence.repair_regression: The contract admits multiple plausible fixes: direct packet membership alone misses effects declared through the default overload, default-only delegation misses direct packet declarations, and conservatively retaining every packet breaks pure-call elimination. A correct repair must unify the effect declarations while preserving ordinary dead-code elimination.
